membership_inputs: raw QC code and pinned dictionary

tasks.measurement_caveat: true-positive count; exact denominator/load mapping unresolved
exact unit and aggregation semantics unresolved

reference_a.rule: earliest non-continuation complete synchronized five-task V/F occasion

primary_vf.rule: first two non-continuation complete synchronized five-task V/F occasions

reselected_strict_v.rule: first two non-continuation complete synchronized five-task V-only occasions
reselected_strict_v.interpretation: changes eligibility and, for four participants, visit selection

fixed_primary_pair_strict_v.rule: retain Primary selected pair; require all ten task records to have raw QC V

crossfit.rationale: uses the approved 109-person Reference A, excludes each analysed participant from its own fit, retains all 57 non-target auxiliaries, and reproduces the historically implemented 98/99 identity rule
crossfit.fold_algorithm: lexicographically sort target participant_id; numpy 2.5.2 default_rng(42).permuted; assign zero-based permutation index modulo 5
crossfit.training_rule: all 57 auxiliaries plus targets not assigned to held-out fold
crossfit.vonly_handling: reuse the Primary target-fold map and the same V/F Reference-A fitting parameters; restrict target rows only; do not create a new sensitivity fitting population
crossfit.alternative_for_later_sensitivity: Design A literal seeded full-reference folding (87/88 training); scientifically defensible but not recommended primary
crossfit.rejected_without_superseding_decision: Design C target-only fitting because it is not the approved 109-person Reference A

M0.center: arithmetic mean of finite y training rows for task/fold
M0.sd_sensitivity: sample standard deviation of y with ddof=1
M0.participant_visits: same participant fold and parameters applied to both visits
M0.missing_nonfinite_score: coordinate null; reason missing_or_nonfinite_score; no imputation

M1.age_field: Step3B session_age; age at repository session, not proven exact cognitive-assessment age
M1.fit: ordinary least squares with intercept: y=intercept+slope*session_age
M1.training_age_rule: exclude a training identity for that task/fold M1 fit if age is missing/nonfinite; record effective identities/count/hash; M0 training is unchanged
M1.minimum_rank: at least two distinct finite ages and full rank [1,age]; otherwise M1 parameter fit unsupported
M1.sd_residual_sensitivity: sample SD of training residuals, ddof=1
M1.support: inclusive [minimum finite training age, maximum finite training age] per task/fold
M1.fallback: separate fallback_model=M0 and fallback_coordinate; never place M0 value in an M1 coordinate field

scale_failure_policy.exact_degeneracy: refuse if computed scale == 0 or all finite training values/residuals are identical
scale_failure_policy.numerical_degeneracy: refuse if scale <= 64*machine_epsilon*max(training_range,abs(scale)); this uses scale/spread, not center or arbitrary score origin
scale_failure_policy.representability_check: separately warn when observed training range is near floating-point spacing at the values' magnitudes
scale_failure_policy.small_valid_scale: do not refuse solely because MAD is below an absolute universal cutoff
scale_failure_policy.scientific_warning: report influence, concentration/ties, and SD/MAD diagnostics separately; never silently substitute SD for MAD

outputs.combined_note: 970 is a stratified concatenation and may repeat physical source records; it is not a unique physical-source union
outputs.variant_expansion: if M0/M1 and MAD/SD are emitted long, expected coordinate rows must be declared as source rows multiplied by emitted valid model-scale variants; variants are not new observations

bootstrap.historical_thresholds: 5000 valid from at most 10000 attempts and 95% feasibility threshold are historical/proposed operational values, not coverage guarantees

required_before_production: Design B and candidate fold identity hashes
bootstrap protocol if bootstrap is later run

canonical_hashing: SHA-256 of this UTF-8 file as written; the digest is stored only in milestone_artifact_manifest.csv to avoid self-reference
